common_comparators.sham: Same parameter draw, initial state, OU innovations, runtime, and detector; all u_E,u_I,u_T,u_R channels are zero.
common_comparators.matched_nonpersonalized: For a future eligible N>=3 set only, construct for each subject s a leave-one-subject-out componentwise-median parameter vector from the other certified Night-1 models, freeze it before evaluation, and apply the same fixed-grid policy-selection algorithm. Current status: NOT_ESTIMABLE.
common_comparators.wrong_subject: For a future eligible N>=3 set only, sort subjects by SHA256(campaign_id+'|'+subject_id), cyclically shift the selected subject-specific policy by one position, and apply the shifted policy to the recipient's own model with paired randomness. Current status: NOT_ESTIMABLE.
common_comparators.subject_interaction: On disjoint evaluation seeds define target-oriented benefit G_s(u). Let u_s be the smallest-absolute-dose maximizer on training seeds, u_pop the matched-nonpersonalized maximizer, and u_wrong(s) the cyclic wrong-subject policy. Report I_pop=median_s[G_s(u_s)-G_s(u_pop)] and I_wrong=median_s[G_s(u_s)-G_s(u_wrong(s))], plus R_between=median pairwise L2 distance between standardized subject dose-response curves divided by the median within-subject bootstrap curve distance.

common_statistics.phase2a_uncertainty: Paired hierarchical percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, PCG64(860216), resampling parameter draws then paired seeds; two-sided 95% interval.
common_statistics.phase2b_uncertainty: Nested paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, PCG64(860219), resampling subjects, then within-subject parameter/posterior draws and paired seeds; simultaneous two-sided 95% intervals.
common_statistics.test: Paired sign-flip test on block-level target-oriented effects with 100000 Monte Carlo flips from PCG64(860217); circular targets use paired subject-label permutation with the same draw count.
common_statistics.secondary_multiplicity: Gate-kept Holm step-down alpha=0.05 across T2,T3,T5,T7 only if at least one primary passes; otherwise descriptive.
common_statistics.exploratory_multiplicity: T8 is descriptive/exploratory and ineligible for V2 advancement.
common_statistics.formal_c2_interaction_threshold: Both I_pop and I_wrong lower simultaneous 95% confidence bounds must exceed 0.25 sham-standard-deviation units and R_between lower 95% bound must exceed 1.5.
common_statistics.target_decision_family: F_TARGET_DECISIONS contains every registered scalar target margin across T1-T8 and uses 10000 paired hierarchical resamples from PCG64(860218), a studentized max-absolute-deviation statistic, and the 9501st order statistic. Every listed scalar lower band must exceed zero; Holm p-values are separate.
common_statistics.level_b_family: F_LEVEL_B_SURFACES jointly covers every executed cell across at most three 5x5 surfaces with PCG64(860220).
common_statistics.cross_target_family: F_CROSS_TARGET_8X8 jointly covers all 64 cells with fixed policies and verifier-seed resampling using PCG64(860221); missing cells remain NOT_ESTIMABLE and invalidate that policy row for complete off-target support.

targets.physiological_interpretation: Dominant slow-oscillation frequency tracking and entrainment within the model observation proxy.
targets.exact_dependent_variable: Welch dominant peak frequency f_SO in 0.4-1.5 Hz; supportive lock metric is SO-to-drive PLV.
targets.units: Hz for f_SO; dimensionless [0,1] for PLV
targets.baseline_value: f0=median f_SO over the 36 paired sham seed-draw blocks; PLV0 is computed against each registered reference frequency. This is a prespecified estimand and is not yet observed.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Bidirectional movement toward both the registered low drive (0.55 Hz) and high drive (1.15 Hz), with frequency locking rather than a single favorable peak.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: u_E(t)=0.8*sin(2*pi*f_d*t); every other input is zero.
targets.sham_or_no_control: All input channels zero with paired OU streams.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model and pooled fixed-grid frequency policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged subject frequency policy applied to recipient model; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.effect_estimand: E1=0.5*((abs(f0-0.55)-abs(f_low-0.55))+(abs(f0-1.15)-abs(f_high-1.15))) in Hz, paired by seed and draw; f_low and f_high are outputs at the two registered endpoint drives.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common I_pop, I_wrong, and R_between with G_s equal to the negative mean absolute peak-to-drive error standardized by sham seed uncertainty.
targets.practical_margin: E1>=0.05 Hz, PLV>=0.50 at both endpoint drives, and at least 80% of valid blocks move closer to each drive.
targets.decision_threshold: Every T1 F_TARGET_DECISIONS slack has simultaneous lower bound>0: E1-0.05 Hz, both endpoint PLV-0.50, and both move-fraction-0.80; applicable Holm-adjusted p<0.05; >=30 valid pairs; all vetoes pass.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation paired hierarchical bootstrap; formal Phase2B uses the frozen nested subject family.
targets.stability_rule: At least 95% of all prescribed runs stable; no boundary peak, divergence, clipping, saturation, or invalid spectrum.
targets.multiplicity_rule: Primary Holm family T1,T4,T6 at alpha=0.05.
targets.failure_rule: D if valid but any efficacy/robustness threshold fails; F if apparent tracking is forced spectral leakage, boundary selection, instability, detector drift, or protocol violation; NOT_ESTIMABLE if denominators fail.
targets.personalization_requirement: Formal C2 additionally requires N>=3 certified subjects and both interaction contrasts plus R_between to pass the common threshold; synthetic draws do not count.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: bounded generic forcing shifted and locked the dominant slow-frequency proxy within PHASE2_CONTROL_BENCH_V1; non-transferable diagnostic evidence.
targets.prohibited_claim: Personalized entrainment, auditory stimulation efficacy, human slow-wave control, clinical control, C1, C2, or evidence about the unidentified R4 executable.

targets.exact_dependent_variable: Median peak-to-peak x amplitude over retained 0.3-1.5 Hz SO events.
targets.baseline_value: A0=median T2 amplitude over sham paired blocks; prespecified and not yet observed.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Predictable bidirectional amplitude response across negative and positive cortical bias without global gain inflation.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: u_E(t)=d and all other inputs zero.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model with its fixed-grid DC policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged DC policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.effect_estimand: E2=(A(+1.5)-A(-1.5))/A0, paired by block; A0 must exceed 0.10 m.u.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s equal to signed fractional amplitude change while satisfying specificity vetoes.
targets.practical_margin: E2>=0.15 and both endpoint amplitudes differ from sham in opposite registered directions by at least 5%.
targets.decision_threshold: Every T2 F_TARGET_DECISIONS slack has simultaneous lower bound>0: E2-0.15 and both endpoint fractional changes-0.05; dose order in >=4 of 6 draws; gate-kept Holm p<0.05; >=30 valid pairs; no veto.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation paired hierarchical bootstrap; nested subject bootstrap if future eligible.
targets.stability_rule: Common stability rules plus A0>0.10 m.u. and no >25% broadband-power rise without SO-band fraction increase.
targets.failure_rule: D for valid submargin/nonrobust response; F for global scaling, detector-threshold artifact, saturation, instability, or invalid SO cycles; NOT_ESTIMABLE when event minimum fails.
targets.personalization_requirement: Common formal C2 interaction rule with N>=3; unavailable and not replaceable by synthetic draws.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: bounded cortical generic forcing altered SO amplitude in the clean-room bench without registered global-gain vetoes.
targets.prohibited_claim: Human SO-amplitude modulation, treatment benefit, personalized control, C1, C2, or R4-candidate response.

targets.physiological_interpretation: Rate of detector-qualified slow-oscillation cycles in the model proxy.
targets.exact_dependent_variable: SO events per minute using the fixed cycle detector.
targets.baseline_value: D0=sham SO event density for each paired seed-draw block and its across-block median; prespecified and not yet observed.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Positive pulses increase and negative pulses decrease event density while cycle morphology remains valid.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: 80 ms cortical-E pulses at 0.85 Hz with signed amplitude d; all other inputs zero.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model with pooled pulse-dose policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged pulse policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.effect_estimand: E3=D(+2.0)-D(-2.0) events/min, paired by seed and draw.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s equal to target-oriented density change after morphology and regime vetoes.
targets.practical_margin: E3>=3.0 events/min and each endpoint differs from sham by at least 1.5 events/min in the registered direction.
targets.decision_threshold: Every T3 F_TARGET_DECISIONS slack has simultaneous lower bound>0: E3-3.0 and both endpoint density changes-1.5 events/min; gate-kept Holm p<0.05; >=30 valid pairs; fixed detector/morphology; no veto.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation paired hierarchical bootstrap; nested subject bootstrap if future eligible.
targets.stability_rule: Common stability rules; retained duration >=160 s and median SO amplitude remains 0.10-2.00 m.u.
targets.failure_rule: D for valid submargin response; F if count changes arise from threshold crossings, shortened retained duration, pulse-count aliasing, instability, silence, or regime collapse.
targets.personalization_requirement: Common formal C2 interaction rule with N>=3; unavailable under V2.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: bounded generic cortical pulses changed fixed-detector SO event density within the clean-room bench.
targets.prohibited_claim: Increased human slow waves, improved sleep, personalized stimulation, C1, C2, or R4-candidate control.

targets.physiological_interpretation: Occurrence rate of detector-qualified spindle-like sigma events.
targets.exact_dependent_variable: Spindle events per minute from the sham-calibrated fixed sigma-RMS detector.
targets.baseline_value: S0=sham spindle density for each paired block and its across-block median; zero is valid when retained duration is valid.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Relay-directed packets increase and reticular-directed packets decrease spindle density.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: At fs=200 Hz packet p starts at s_p=floor(p*200/0.85+0.5); internal start is 30000+5*s_p and the exact 500-step Hann/nonnegative-13-Hz packet is injected into T for d>=0 or R for d<0.
targets.sham_or_no_control: d=0 with paired OU streams and sham-derived detector thresholds.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model with pooled packet-balance policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged packet policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.effect_estimand: E4=S(+1.5)-S(-1.5) events/min, paired by seed and draw.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s equal to target-oriented spindle-density change after sigma-specificity and rate vetoes.
targets.practical_margin: E4>=1.0 spindle/min, each endpoint differs from sham by at least 0.5 spindle/min in the registered direction, and >50% of matched-counterfactual ADDED events at d=+1.5 contain an autonomous full sigma cycle after packet offset.
targets.decision_threshold: Every T4 member of F_TARGET_DECISIONS has simultaneous lower slack bound>0, including E4-1.0, both endpoint-minus-sham 0.5-spindle/min margins, and autonomous-added-event fraction-0.50; primary Holm-adjusted p<0.05; >=30 valid pairs; >=95% stability; no veto.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation paired hierarchical bootstrap plus the separate primary Holm test; nested subject bootstrap if future eligible.
targets.stability_rule: Common rules; detector retained-duration fraction>=0.85 and sigma-band fraction must increase for an increase claim.
targets.failure_rule: Use the frozen one-to-one <=0.250 s peak-time matcher. NOT_ESTIMABLE if N_added<30 or fewer than 10 blocks contain added events. PASS requires the simultaneous lower bound for F_auto-0.50>0. D applies to a valid submargin/nonrobust result when F_replica<0.50. F applies when F_replica>=0.50 or matching, detector, packet timing, broadband, or instability artifact materially generates the effect.
targets.personalization_requirement: Common formal C2 interaction rule with N>=3; unavailable under V2.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: relay-versus-reticular generic packets changed spindle-like event density within PHASE2_CONTROL_BENCH_V1 under fixed detection.
targets.prohibited_claim: Human spindle induction, auditory stimulation, memory benefit, personalized control, C1, C2, or R4 response.

targets.sham_or_no_control: d=0 with paired OU streams and sham-calibrated detector thresholds.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model with pooled sigma-balance policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged sigma policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s equal to signed fractional event-RMS change conditional on specificity.
targets.practical_margin: E5>=0.15 and each endpoint differs from sham by at least 5% in the registered direction.
targets.decision_threshold: Every T5 F_TARGET_DECISIONS slack has simultaneous lower bound>0: E5-0.15 and both endpoint fractional changes-0.05; gate-kept Holm p<0.05; >=30 valid pairs; >=10 events per condition/block; specificity veto passes.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation paired hierarchical bootstrap; nested subject bootstrap if future eligible.

targets.failure_rule: D for valid submargin response or inadequate events; F for broadband excitation, threshold drift, saturation, instability, or event selection artifact; event insufficiency is NOT_ESTIMABLE rather than zero.
targets.personalization_requirement: Common formal C2 interaction rule with N>=3; unavailable under V2.

targets.prohibited_claim: Human spindle strength, enhanced sleep physiology, personalized intervention, C1, C2, or R4 response.

targets.physiological_interpretation: Strength of coordination between slow phase and sigma amplitude in the model proxy.
targets.baseline_value: MI0=paired sham bMI for each seed-draw block and its across-block median; prespecified and not yet observed.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Increase coupling at registered phase 0 relative to sham, with phase-response characterization across the full signed circle.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: Use the exact 200 Hz causal HP(0.3 Hz)-LP(1.5 Hz) scheduler in phase2_protocol.json: phase zero is the accepted filtered upward crossing, period is the median of the last three valid 134-400 sample intervals, signed phase uses forward modulo delay and round-half-up integer scheduling, and the exact 500-step packet is injected into u_T. No filter-delay calibration or subtraction is used.

bounded_bidirectional_range.endpoint_rule: -pi is included; +pi is the duplicate-equivalent endpoint and is not executed

targets.sham_or_no_control: Packet amplitude=0 with the causal detector running and paired OU streams.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model with pooled trigger-phase policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged trigger phase/amplitude policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.

targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s equal to bMI gain at that subject's training-selected grid phase minus sham, standardized by within-subject uncertainty.

targets.decision_threshold: The simultaneous F_TARGET_DECISIONS lower bounds for E6-0.010 and positive-block-fraction-0.75 are both >0, primary Holm-adjusted p<0.05, >=30 valid pairs, >=30 SO cycles and >=10 spindle events per block, and scheduler/surrogate/off-target rules pass.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation paired hierarchical bootstrap including fixed 200-surrogate correction; nested subject bootstrap if future eligible.

targets.failure_rule: D for valid submargin or nonrobust bMI gain; F for edge/filter leakage, trigger-count confounding, event insufficiency presented as zero, packet artifact, unstable rates, or failed surrogate null.

targets.prohibited_claim: Personalized SO-spindle coordination, human memory consolidation, auditory closed-loop efficacy, C1, C2, or R4 control.

targets.physiological_interpretation: Timing of spindle-like maxima relative to slow-oscillation phase.
targets.exact_dependent_variable: Circular mean SO phase of the maximum sigma envelope within each retained spindle event.
targets.baseline_value: phi0=paired sham circular mean when resultant length R>=0.20 and event/cycle minima hold; otherwise NOT_ESTIMABLE.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Measured preferred phase tracks both negative and positive registered trigger offsets rather than merely changing coupling magnitude.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: Same exact causal scheduler as T6. The requested signed phase is canonicalized to [-pi,pi), mapped forward modulo 2*pi to an integer delay from the accepted crossing, and negative offsets are delivered later in the current estimated cycle; no retrospective scheduling or delay calibration is permitted.
targets.sham_or_no_control: Packet amplitude=0 with causal detector running and paired OU streams.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model with pooled phase policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged phase policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.effect_estimand: E7 comprises circular-circular correlation rho_c between requested and observed phase, median absolute circular tracking error, and circular separation between observed outputs at requested -pi/2 and +pi/2.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s=-absolute circular tracking error standardized by sham phase uncertainty.
targets.practical_margin: rho_c>=0.70, median tracking error<=pi/6, and lower 95% bound on output separation for requested -pi/2 versus +pi/2 >=pi/3.
targets.decision_threshold: The F_TARGET_DECISIONS simultaneous lower bounds for circular-correlation-0.70, pi/6-minus-tracking-error, and observed separation at the executed -pi/2 and +pi/2 conditions minus pi/3 are all >0; gate-kept Holm-adjusted circular permutation p<0.05; >=30 valid pairs; event and concentration minima pass.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation bootstrap after circular means/differences are wrapped and converted to registered scalar slacks; raw circular half-width>=pi is NOT_ESTIMABLE; nested subject bootstrap if future eligible.
targets.stability_rule: Common rules plus resultant length R>=0.20; coupling-strength change alone cannot pass T7.
targets.failure_rule: D for valid but poor tracking/separation; F if apparent phase shifts arise only from changed event selection, filter delay, edge leakage, low concentration, or instability; insufficient events are NOT_ESTIMABLE.
targets.personalization_requirement: Common formal C2 interaction rule with N>=3 and subject-specific phase policies exceeding circular uncertainty; unavailable under V2.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: registered trigger offsets shifted spindle-like preferred phase within the clean-room bench, separately from coupling strength.
targets.prohibited_claim: Human spindle timing prescription, personalized phase targeting, causal human timing control, C1, C2, or R4 response.

targets.physiological_interpretation: Transition between prospectively defined model dynamical regimes, not a clinical sleep-state transition.
targets.exact_dependent_variable: Fraction of six adjacent 25 s windows [15,40),[40,65),[65,90),[90,115),[115,140),[140,165) s satisfying every mixed SO-spindle model-regime criterion.
targets.detector_metric_implementation: phase2_protocol.json#observation_and_detector_contract/T8; each 25 s window uses Hann Welch fs=200,nperseg=5000,noverlap=0,nfft=10000, with global 180 s filtering, sham threshold calibration over [10,170) s, and strict within-window event containment.
targets.baseline_value: O0=sham mixed-regime occupancy across the six exact 25 s windows in each paired block and its median; prespecified and not yet observed.
targets.desired_intervention_direction: Demonstrate a persistent bidirectional occupancy range across inhibitory/reticular versus excitatory/relay forcing without silence, saturation, or transient instability.
targets.intervention_to_model_mapping: For d>=0 inject (u_E,u_T)=(d,0.5d); for d<0 inject (u_I,u_R)=(-d,-0.5d); unused inputs zero.
targets.matched_nonpersonalized_comparator: Leave-one-subject-out median model with pooled regime policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.wrong_subject_comparator: Cyclic hash-deranged regime policy; unavailable under V2 because N=0.
targets.effect_estimand: E8=max_d O(d)-min_d O(d) over the complete fixed grid, paired by seed and draw; extrema use smallest absolute dose then smaller signed dose for ties.
targets.subject_interaction_estimand: Use common interaction estimands with G_s equal to occupancy gain toward the registered mixed regime, standardized by within-subject uncertainty.
targets.practical_margin: E8>=1/3, the high-occupancy state persists for >=2 consecutive windows, and at least two adjacent nonzero doses support the same direction.
targets.decision_threshold: The F_TARGET_DECISIONS simultaneous lower bound for E8-1/3 is >0, >=30 valid paired blocks, two consecutive exact 25 s windows and adjacent-dose support pass, and every component/hard stability rule passes; exploratory and ineligible for V2 advancement.
targets.uncertainty_method: F_TARGET_DECISIONS studentized max-deviation paired hierarchical bootstrap; nested subject bootstrap if future eligible.
targets.statistical_test: Common paired sign-flip test reported descriptively without confirmatory multiplicity claim.
targets.stability_rule: Every regime-positive window must meet all registered rate, SO, spindle, spectral, and solver bounds; silence, saturation, clipping, or transient blow-up is INVALID.
targets.multiplicity_rule: Exploratory descriptive target; ineligible for Candidate V2 Phase2B advancement.
targets.failure_rule: D for valid submargin or nonpersistent occupancy response; F if a transition is caused by instability, silence, saturation, clipping, detector collapse, or a single isolated window.
targets.personalization_requirement: Common formal C2 interaction rule with N>=3 would be required in a new protocol version; unavailable under V2.
targets.allowed_claim: After valid execution only: balanced generic forcing changed occupancy of a prospectively defined model regime in PHASE2_CONTROL_BENCH_V1.
targets.prohibited_claim: Sleep-stage transition in humans, movement toward a clinically beneficial attractor, personalized state control, C1, C2, or R4 response.
